items.title: One Order Model
items.description: Every sale — webshop, POS, WhatsApp, QR, cash — lands in the same order feed. One source of truth, one set of statuses, no channel silos.

items.title: Subscriptions & Memberships
items.description: Recurring billing, family plans, QR check-in, automated renewals. Built for the clubs, gyms and associations that enterprise software priced out.

items.title: Point of Sale
items.description: Turn any device into a register. Card, cash, QR — parked carts, split payments, real-time sync with your online shop. No extra hardware required.

items.title: Honest Reporting
items.description: Revenue, tax, products, payouts — broken down by channel, period and category. Export-ready, accountant-friendly, owned by you.

items.title: Multi-language CMS
items.description: Pages, blog, menus — manage your content in every language your customers speak. SEO-ready, mobile-first, no plugin marketplace.

items.title: Fast Everywhere
items.description: Deployed on a global edge network. Sub-50ms response times in 300+ cities — the same speed in Lagos as in London.
